summary: Independent verification reproduced every load-bearing claim. Scope is exactly the six delegated tracked files (PLANS.md, README.md, docs/plan/state.json, docs/release/build-and-release.md, docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md, manifest.json) plus the new docs/implementation/21.3/ report directory; no source, test, build-metadata, or immutable-history file changed, and no commit or tag was created. Reproducibility: I exported a clean tree myself (git ls-files, 1,085 files, no .git/bin/obj/artifacts) at a new absolute path, ran restore/build/package (0 warnings / 0 errors) and produced artifacts/ArrTags_1.2.0.0.zip byte-identical to the recorded identity - 619,538 bytes, SHA-256 505804992a50d7aa073b07cfaa8dc0c8ac9a95041a7c394d8bd54dd959f90762, MD5 3100aae94a2b4aedf222eca040675271 - and independently recomputed all 7 per-entry sizes and SHA-256 values, which match the release document exactly. Suites: default with the archive present 0/1927/66/1993 (4 consecutive runs, stable), default without the archive 0/1924/69/1993, host-guarded against the pinned host 0/1947/46/1993, forced-native 0/2014/21/2035 (4 of 5 runs; see 21.3-R4). Skip taxonomy is honest: a TRX run of the default tier shows exactly 66 NotExecuted results partitioned 20 pinned-host + 45 ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT (41 round-trip facts + 4 golden/cross-runtime entries, matching the 4 SkiaNativeTheory attributes in the suite) + 1 ARRTAGS_NONCANONICAL_GOLDENS, and 1947-1927 = 20 host facts genuinely execute under ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR. The pinned host is real (Jellyfin.Api.dll present; console.log logs 'Jellyfin version: 12.0.0'). manifest.json is valid JSON, lists 1.2.0.0 first with checksum equal to the artifact MD5, correct targetAbi 12.0.0.0 and v1.2.0 sourceUrl, retains 1.1.0.0 and 1.0.1.0, and regenerates byte-identically (timestamp-normalised) from build.yaml via scripts/write-manifest.cs. scripts/check-docs.sh FAILs only on the contract-mandated 'task 21.3 has a worker report but no reviewer report' pairing line, which this report closes; every other section passes, including 'artifact identity agrees (sha256, md5, bytes)' for the retained 1.1.0.0 identity. render-docs-state --check is clean, so the generated blocks need no regeneration. The worker's state edits (task done/reports, updated_utc, PLANS.md checkbox) are inside the single-writer rule; current_release, releases status, and the tag surface were correctly left to 21.6, and no v1.2 live-matrix results were added (21.4). Three informational notes recorded, none blocking.

The trailing clause was updated by this task, but the 'previous release' descriptor for 1.0.1.0 was left as it stood when 1.1.0.0 was current. The same document's 'Release artifact identity' section correctly demotes 1.1.0.0 to 'the prior release', so the file is internally inconsistent about which release is the previous one. The 1.1.0.0 matrix itself is not lost: it remains in docs/plan/state.json current_release.suite, docs/changelog/v1.1.0.md, and docs/limitations/accepted.md. This is a wording-precision issue in history prose; it affects no artifact identity, suite count, release step, or acceptance criterion, so it is recorded as noted rather than required.
